与自然一起成长(Growing up with nature): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:本的经历、感受与成长。

The forest path looked quieter than usual that evening. At first, Ben found it difficult to keep the habit. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Best of all, rabbits have long ears.
Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Ben thanked Max for the honest advice. Ben believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. For example, plants need rich soil to grow well.

What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Ben keeps a small dog at home and feeds it every morning. The experience taught Ben more than any book could. Best of all, deadheading prolongs the roses.

On Monday evenings, Ben reviews the notes from class. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. People around Ben often share different ideas about the forest path. Also, a bog garden suits pitcher plants.
Ben usually spends the weekend reading at the supermarket. Max and Ben are preparing a report about the forest path. Ben wrote down every idea in a small notebook.
